name: Fushimi Rio
source:
"Ah! It's Ruri there!"

Class 2, Grade 1, Fujitsubo School

Ever since she was adopted in childhood by the owner of the library, she has been dwelling and working as a maid here. She is a positive and somewhat innocent girl who pacifies the atmosphere with her warm smile. She is good at domestic work, especially cooking, and pleases everyone at the dining table.

She has been loving the protagonist from childhood, and has never tried to conceal this feeling. Conscious that the feeling will not receive any response, however, she has never expected or wished anything. She is living with plenty of worries and concerns.

[Translated from [url=http://kagura.rdy.jp/kamimaho/character_rio.html]official website[/url]]
